tools.name: list_events
tools.description: All upcoming concerts with date, line-up, genres and a price/availability summary. Amounts are euro cents.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details of one concert: bio, line-up, other dates of the same run, prices and availability.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Live ticket availability for a concert, per session: the stock_id, category_id and price_id values that hold_tickets needs, with prices in euro cents and the maximum quantity per line.

tools.name: get_venue_info
tools.description: Address, contact details and the venue's FAQ (house rules, practical questions). Use this to answer buyer questions about the club instead of guessing.

tools.name: hold_tickets
tools.description: Reserves tickets and returns a booking_uuid. The hold expires after 15 minutes if the order is not paid, releasing the seats. Only call this once the buyer has chosen; do not hold speculatively.

tools.name: set_contact
tools.description: Attaches the buyer to a held booking and returns the payment_url. Give that URL to the human buyer: payment (card or Bancontact) happens in their browser, never through this API. The tickets will be emailed to the address given here.

tools.name: redeem_pass
tools.description: Applies a Toots Pass code (given to you by the buyer; format XXX-XXXXXX-XXX) to a held booking, after set_contact. Covers as many tickets as the pass has concerts left. If the order is fully covered the booking completes immediately (status paid); otherwise the response carries the payment_url for t

tools.name: redeem_gift_card
tools.description: Applies a Toots gift card code (given to you by the buyer) to a held booking, after set_contact. Uses as much of the card's balance as the order needs. Fully covered orders complete immediately (status paid); otherwise the response carries the payment_url for the balance.

tools.name: release_booking
tools.description: Gives an unpaid hold's seats back immediately, instead of letting them sit reserved until the 15-minute expiry. Call this when the buyer changes their mind. Paid bookings cannot be released.

tools.name: wait_for_payment
tools.description: Like get_booking_status, but holds the request open (up to 25 seconds) and returns as soon as the booking is paid. Call it after handing the buyer the payment_url instead of polling in a loop; repeat while status is still awaiting_payment and the hold has time left.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Current status of a booking: awaiting_contact, awaiting_payment (with payment_url and amount left), paid or expired. A paid booking carries ticket_url — the one link to share with the buyer, which adapts to their device (wallet on a phone, PDF and choices elsewhere) — plus the explicit ticket_pdf_ur

tools.name: recover_tickets
tools.description: For a buyer who lost their tickets: sends the ticket links of their past paid orders to their email address. The links go to the inbox only — the response never contains them — so the inbox is the proof of ownership. Tell the buyer to check their email (and spam folder).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "redeem_pass" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "redeem_gift_card" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_availability, recover_tickets · Private data: get_venue_info, set_contact, redeem_pass, get_booking_status · Public sink: get_booking_status, recover_tickets · Destructive: get_event, redeem_pass.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_availability, recover_tickets · Private data: get_venue_info, set_contact, redeem_pass, get_booking_status · Public sink: get_booking_status, recover_tickets · Destructive: get_event, redeem_pass

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
